title: Safe Withdrawal Rate Calculator
requiredEvidence: Licensed/versioned historical return and inflation data or explicitly selected stochastic model with calibration and reproducible seed policy.
Qualified choice of sequence risk, horizon, fees/tax, withdrawal rule and success/failure criterion; independent multi-path validation, not a generic compound-interest page.

title: Pension Calculator
requiredEvidence: Named plan and complete effective plan documents: benefit type, accrual/reference salary, vesting, retirement age, survivor choices, COLA and contribution rules.
Plan-authorized worked cases and pension specialist reconciliation, including ineligible/early retirement branches.

title: Overtime Pay Calculator
requiredEvidence: Complete accessible governing overtime text with jurisdiction, effective dates, coverage/exemptions, regular-rate inclusions and daily/weekly/premium interactions.
Qualified payroll/legal review and official examples including boundaries/exemptions; a synthetic1.5multiplier is not authority.

title: Pregnancy Due Date Calculator
requiredEvidence: Complete applicable obstetric dating/redating guidance and revision, with gestational counting and LMP/cycle/ultrasound/assisted-reproduction branches.
Qualified obstetric review of applicability, exceptions and official reference cases; LMP+280 alone is not clinical acceptance.

title: Conception Calculator
requiredEvidence: Approved dating basis tied to#405 and validated uncertainty interval with calendar conventions and clinical exclusions.
Qualified reproductive-health review; explicit prohibition on exact fertilization/intercourse/paternity inference, plus independent uncertainty reference cases.

title: Cooking Time Adjustment Calculator
requiredEvidence: Food/geometry/appliance-specific validated thermal/time model, calibration dataset, initial/boundary conditions and predictive uncertainty.
Qualified food-safety review and independent validation over declared operating range. Minimum endpoint temperature tables are safety evidence, not an adjusted-time formula.
